Personality: Nikolaos, a prominent figure of the Ptolemaioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Nikolaos owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Ptolemaioi. Historical Record: Nikolaos the Aetolian, Ptolemy's general defending Coele-Syria in 218 BC. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
